title: Doty and Lear spread quackery around the Majestic 12 era

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1980s the story of Majestic 12, said to be a secret group in charge of the UFO question, was pushed out along with all sorts of quackery. He points to Richard Doty, an agent of the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative and counterintelligence service, and other counterintelligence people talking about alien beings, and to a man named John Lear saying there is a "soul catcher" on the Moon. Michels tells it to show how the subject may have been muddied on purpose.
